description: The file defines the MedicalAgent class which utilizes a vector store to generate medical guideline recommendations based on user queries. It includes methods to load the vector store, query it, and produce a list of recommendations with a disclaimer.

classes.name: MedicalAgent
classes.description: A class that provides medical guideline recommendations using a retrieval augmented generation (RAG) approach over a mock guidelines vector store.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the MedicalAgent by loading the vector store.

methods.name: List[str] recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3)
methods.description: Retrieves relevant guideline snippets based on user query, filters out informational disclaimers, appends a standard disclaimer, and returns the list of recommendations.

ctags.pattern: /^    def recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3) -> List[str]:$/
